The '''Walalla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the planet [[Walalla]]. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the Walalla system was located within the [[Seventh Security Zone]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
